EuroTrip is a wild teen comedy about a recent high school graduate, Scott Thomas, who travels across Europe to meet his German pen pal, Mieke. After misunderstanding her messages and accidentally offending her, Scott realizes she actually likes him, so he and his friends—Cooper, Jenny, and Jamie—set off on a chaotic trip through cities like London, Paris, and Rome. Along the way, they experience culture shocks, crazy parties, and a series of hilarious misunderstandings.

The film is known for its over-the-top humor, iconic scenes, and memorable characters like the eccentric tour guide and the creepy Italian man. It mixes raunchy comedy with a light coming-of-age story as Scott learns about friendship and taking risks. While it’s not a deep movie, EuroTrip became a cult favorite for its outrageous jokes, catchy moments, and its fun portrayal of a backpacking adventure across Europe.
